name: Bến Cảng
title_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE shallow horizontal scenery panorama for a mobile game's stage-name background, matching an approved set.

Primary request: Bến Cảng region. Generate only the new regional scenery. The 3px brown outline and the title text will be composed separately; do not bake them into the art.

Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED Meadow panorama, the exact reference for horizontal framing, rounded shapes, closed flat colors, contour weight and broad restrained shading. Preserve this art language while replacing the meadow subject with the requested region. Image 2 is the game's orange cat, a supporting style reference only; do not draw the cat, its face or its weapon.

Regional scene: A friendly little harbor: pale turquoise sea, low distant blue-green coastline, simple wooden dock piles and a chunky moored boat cropped in the outer thirds. A few warm sandy warehouses at the far side. Quiet water and low coastline behind the center label, clean pale blue sky. No people, no writing or flags.

Composition: a very wide and shallow miniature landscape. Intended final display is 476x90, with a 3px brown inside outline added separately, no carton lip or shadow. Put all important motifs between roughly 25 and 75 percent of the raw image height, ready for a shallow center crop. Large identifying silhouettes belong mainly to the outer thirds. Keep the center reasonably quiet and medium toned for separately overlaid white text with brown outline. No huge empty foreground, no deep vertical composition. One cohesive panoramic view, not a collage.

Style: match Image 1 as a member of the SAME asset set. Clean casual 2D cartoon, broad chunky rounded masses, smooth warm olive-brown structural contours, simple closed color fills, at most one broad shadow tone per mass. Limit the palette to a few related colors. Background linework stays quieter than the character. Friendly hand-drawn shapes without brush texture. Details must survive the tiny final size; avoid tiny decorative dashes, fine scratches or thin gray edging.

Constraints: scenery ONLY. NO text, lettering, numbers, labels, UI, border, frame, rounded rectangle, plaque, ribbon, button, arrow, stars, characters, cats, king portrait or floating island. No isometric view, realistic stone or wood texture, 3D render, glossy lighting, grain, gradients used as volume rendering, painterly strokes, dramatic bloom, sparks or excessive details. Do not copy the reference's meadow objects into a different biome. No variants or contact sheet: exactly one regional panorama.
battlefield_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: separate 2D battlefield GROUND texture for a portrait casual mobile cat defense game, not a title banner or a lobby illustration.
Primary request: one complete regional battlefield ground illustration, edge-to-edge, without a frame or lettering.
Input images: Image 1 is the orange cat hero, a STYLE reference only: use its friendly rounded geometry, clean controlled warm dark-brown contours, closed flat colors and one broad shadow tone. Do not draw the cat. Image 2 is the matching region's approved TITLE panorama: use its regional colors and materials ONLY, not its horizon, sky or scenic composition. For stages after 1, Image 3 is the accepted ground-only pilot: match its ground camera, visual density and line treatment, changing the biome.
Camera and composition: orthographic top-down/slightly-downward 2D game ground. View ONLY the ground surface filling the ENTIRE square-ish image, including the top edge. Absolutely NO sky, horizon, distant skyline, landscape vista or side-view scene. Vertical enemy movement travels from the image top toward its bottom. This is NOT an isometric floating island.
Layout contract at a logical 720 x 740: quiet open walkable ground spans x96..624 and y0..740. Important units can also enter near x44 and x676. Large environmental objects must be heavily cropped by the extreme left/right edges within approximately x0..65 and x655..720, their shapes extend outside the picture, not isolated objects inside the arena. Keep top-center fully open because enemies enter from ABOVE. The lower section must remain the same quiet terrain; the player's cardboard castle and gear table are separate sprites and will cover the lower foreground later.
Visual style: clean polished flat cartoon matching the cat, large rounded masses, very sparse short detail marks, tidy consistent warm brown outline on edge props, secondary internal contours thinner. Soft broad ground color patches without heavy outlines. At native 720px width the primary prop contour is about 4px, internal creases about 2.5px. Ground stays brighter and less saturated than character sprites so troops read first. No lighting bloom, painted texture, grain, photo detail, tiny mottled dots, noisy cracks or dark center vignette.
Constraints: TERRAIN ONLY. Do not draw any cats, heroes, enemies, animals, troops, weapons, gear, gears, UI, icons, text, numbers, logo, map name, borders, frame, castle of the player, gear table or buildings in the center. No baked contact shadows of characters. Do not place large props along the top or bottom. Do not draw a narrow winding path that constrains the battle to a single column. No perspective horizon, 3D render, isometric, pixel art, painterly shading, realistic materials, dramatic gradients or oversized foreground props.

Region: Bến Cảng
Scene/backdrop: Light warm sand-and-wood harbor quay, pale beige packed ground across the broad open center. Cropped chunky warm-brown dock boards, short mooring posts and a narrow muted teal water strip ONLY at the extreme left and right margins. No boats or water in the playable center, no dock across the top.
Output: single opaque ground-only PNG, almost square 1024x1056.
